segments.text: A woman who manages and operates the YAYOI Inn.

There, she met Yuuma's parents, who ran the YAYOI Inn, and became a good friend, but Yayoi (Yuuma's Mother) died of illness. Yudai (Yuuma's father) entrusted her with the management of the inn and the care of their son, Yuuma.
Mirei is a gentle, motherly and caring woman, she is cheerful and has a strong core, and while running YAYOI Inn, she takes care of her two daughters and her beloved Yuuma.
